name: Dave Brown
bio: Dave Brown of Mingusville was quoted in an April 1886 item on mavericks as saying that ropes came high but he must have them at any price. In May 1886 he and his wife accompanied the newly married Mr. and Mrs. Jack Tisdale to Medora.

moments.label: Quoted on the high price of ropes

mentions: "[MA?]VERICKS?"  Dave. Brown [says?] ropes come high, but he must have them at any price.
Dave. Brown and wife of Mingusville, accompanied Mr. and Mrs. Tisdale to Medora. They returned home Tuesday evening.

Yesterday morning, Mr. and Mrs. Jack Tisdale stepped from the cars and were soon busy accepting the congratulations of their numerous friends. Both are well known here and god-speeds follow them from every side. The marriage ceremony took place at Mingusville …
